An upright long straight continuous STEEL metal shaft with a small squared industrial containment head at its top. The head has two compact silver jaws around one broad CYAN rectangular core in a dark recess; practical futuristic occult technology rather than a medieval wizard staff. Head occupies only the upper quarter of the weapon. Shaft occupies the remaining three quarters, narrow but visibly outlined and with a bright steel longitudinal surface. Include a dark long grip section in the lower half where TWO distinct hands can grasp the same continuous shaft. A simple metal butt cap at bottom. Do not put bulky crossguards, side handles or blades on the shaft.

Upper-left light. No gradients, noise, hairline circuits or realistic texture.
Only ONE complete isolated weapon, vertical, entire shaft visible, genuinely transparent background. No person, hands, arms, scenery, floor, cast shadow, glow, particles, writing, numerals, gold or pink. Keep the long slim shaft clearly different from a short one-handed focalizer.
